newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-,6-mo T-bill yields same,9-mo yields up.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-,6-mo T-bill yields same,9-mo yields up.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills was unchanged at 48.46 percent from the last sale on December 24, a central bank statement said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 18.21 million UAH 25.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 16.25 million UAH 22.30 million UAH
The central bank sold 182,136 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 39,502 were competitive and 142,634 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of three-month discount T-bills will be on December 30.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills was unchanged at 59.36 percent from the last sale on December 24, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 30.04 million UAH 101.52 million UAH
Actual amount raised 23.18 million UAH 78.33 million UAH
The central bank sold 300,421 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 220,749 were competitive and 79,672 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of six-month discount T-bills will be on December 30.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills rose to 61.40 percent from 61.37 percent at the last sale on December 24, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 21.15 million UAH 20.55 million UAH
Actual amount raised 14.49 million UAH 14.09 million UAH
The central bank sold 211,553 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 205,968 were competitive and 5,585 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is December 30.
The Finance Ministry cancelled the sale of 12-month discount treasury bills scheduled for December 26. The next sale of 12-month T-bills will be on January 4.
